args.query: openai.ChatCompletion.create is no longer supported: migrate openai python 0.28 code to the OpenAI client

results.title: OpenAI Python SDK structured outputs, tested with respx
results.summary: Call the OpenAI Python SDK and validate JSON output with Pydantic, testing success, malformed output and API errors offline by mocking HTTP with respx.

results.title: OpenAI Node SDK tool calling + Zod, tested with a mocked fetch
results.summary: Run an OpenAI chat tool-calling loop with Zod-validated tool arguments, tested offline by injecting a fake fetch into the official SDK.

results.title: OpenAI Node SDK streaming chat completions, tested with a mocked SSE fetch
results.summary: Stream chat completion deltas with the OpenAI SDK (for await over chunks), accumulate text and usage, and handle aborts, tested offline with a fake fetch that returns an SSE body.

results.title: OpenAI chat.completions.parse with Pydantic output + respx mocks
results.summary: Get typed output from OpenAI chat.completions.parse using a Pydantic response_format, handle refusals and schema mismatches, and test offline with respx returning canned JSON.

results.title: Flask-SQLAlchemy models with Flask-Migrate upgrades on sqlite in tests
results.summary: Define Flask-SQLAlchemy models, version the schema with Flask-Migrate, and test upgrade, downgrade and model/migration drift offline on a temporary sqlite file.

results.title: Starlette multipart form uploads parsed with python-multipart, tested offline
results.summary: Parse multipart text fields and file uploads in Starlette with python-multipart, then exercise the app fully in-process through httpx.ASGITransport with no network.

results.title: Typed httpx client parsing into pydantic v2 models, tested with respx
results.summary: An async httpx client that retries 5xx and transport errors, validates responses into pydantic v2 models, and is tested offline with respx route mocks.

results.title: python-box dot-access config: frozen boxes, defaults and YAML/JSON roundtrip
results.summary: Build dot-access config objects with python-box, deep-merge overrides and defaults, take frozen read-only views, then convert back to plain dicts and round-trip through YAML and JSON.

results.title: python-slugify + text-unidecode multilingual URL slugs
results.summary: Turn accented, Cyrillic and CJK titles into URL slugs with python-slugify, using text-unidecode for ASCII romanization or allow_unicode to keep scripts verbatim, then dedupe collisions.

results.title: python-docx report with styled tables and page breaks
results.summary: Generate a Word report with python-docx - a title, headings, a styled table and a page break - then reopen the .docx and verify structure, order and styling.
